summary: Kaniksu NF lookout 10 miles north of Nordman, Idaho: pole platform tower in the 1920s, 50-foot L-4 tower in 1935, destroyed 1965; no source describes the site today.

facts.design: 50-foot pole tower with L-4 cab (1935), preceded by a pole platform tower with tent camp (1920s) and an L-4 cab added in 1930
facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1965 per the sources; no source describes what, if anything, remains

staffing.status: two named watchers: Rudy Benson (1933) and Robert L. McVey (1944-1947)

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts lists the site as hike-in; no trail or access rules described

notes_for_editor: Location conflict unresolved: brief lists ffla 48.77094,-116.91133 and idaho_fl 48.77131,-116.94912. The cached Idaho Fire Lookouts page did not show coordinates, so no correction made. Sites trace the 1920s-1935 history to Kresek. The UIdaho item (priestlake183) is a possible photo find, but no image URL was fetched, so none is listed. A pastmaps 1969 map snippet mentions a Plowboy Mine and historic fire station; not read, not cited. The Forest Service Museum record returned 403 and was not used.
